mentions.name: Kumoss
mentions.description: An intent-based infrastructure platform that turns natural-language requests into infrastructure changes while keeping validation, compliance, and existing engineering workflows in the loop. Developers can request any infrastructure need in a web portal, and the request is automatically fulfilled following organization standards defined by the platform team.
mentions.audience: Platform teams define organization standards while developers submit infrastructure requests through a web portal.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Currently we are working on Kumoss Open Source, intent-based infrastructure platform that turns natural-language requests into infrastructure changes, while keeping validation, compliance and existing engineering workflows in the loop.

https://github.com/InditexTech/kumoss

Basically allow developers to request any infrastructure need in a web portal and automatically that request is fulfilled following the organization standards the platform team defined.
mentions.author: luis_valerio
